## What happened?

Describe the expected behavior and actual result.

## Reproduction

Include the skill or script, repository revision, agent/host, and relevant tool versions. Use a minimal synthetic prompt or fixture. Remove personal details, private application HTML, and credentials.

## Evidence

Include relevant redacted output and checks already performed. For sensitive vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md rather than disclosing details here.
